create_InputProcessor: create an InputProcessor instance with VllmConfig to process prompts into EngineCoreRequest objects
process_inputs_prompt: process inputs by converting prompts and SamplingParams into an EngineCoreRequest with validated token IDs and multimodal features
validate_params_SamplingParams: validate SamplingParams against model config, speculative config, and structured outputs config before processing
validate_params_PoolingParams: validate PoolingParams and auto-assign task for pooling models supporting token_embed or token_classify
validate_model_inputs: validate model inputs by checking prompt length, encoder cache size, and token vocabulary bounds
